scenes.vo: Claude made this whole video from one prompt. Here is how you set it up.
Step one. Clone the Claude Video 2 repo from GitHub.
Step two. Copy the folder into your Claude skills folder.
Step three. Make sure Node and FFmpeg are installed.
Step four. Open Claude Code and say, make me a motion graphic.
Step five. Pick a style, answer five quick questions, and Claude renders the whole thing for you.
It is completely free. Grab it from the link on screen.
